_meta.description: Major PHB feats with prerequisites and effects

effects: +5 to initiative
Cannot be surprised while conscious
Other creatures cannot gain advantage on attack rolls against you while hidden
+1 STR or DEX
Climbing, swimming, and jumping costs only 5 ft of movement
Standing up costs only 5 ft of movement
Running high jump covers extra distance equal to DEX mod
+1 CHA
Advantage on Deception and Performance checks when trying to pass as another person
Can mimic the speech of another creature after listening for 1 minute
When using Dash action, can make a melee attack or shove as a bonus action
+5 damage or +10 ft push on charge attack
Ignore loading quality of crossbows
No disadvantage on ranged attack rolls within 5 ft of hostile creature
When attacking with one-handed weapon, can use hand crossbow as bonus action
When wielding a finesse weapon, can use reaction to add proficiency bonus to AC against one attack
+1 AC while wielding two melee weapons
Can two-weapon fight with any melee weapons (not just light)
Can draw/stow two weapons per turn
Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to detect secret doors
Advantage on saving throws against traps
Resistance to trap damage
Can search for traps while traveling at normal pace

Elemental Adept.prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell
effects: Spells of chosen damage type ignore resistance
Treat 1s on damage dice as 2s for chosen type
+1 STR
Advantage on attack rolls against creatures you are grappling
Can pin a creature grappled by you (contested check)
Can grapple creatures up to two sizes larger
On crit or reducing a creature to 0 HP, can make one melee attack as bonus action
Before attacking with heavy weapon, can take -5 to attack roll for +10 damage
+1 STR
Proficiency with heavy armor
+1 STR
Reduce bludgeoning/piercing/slashing damage from nonmagical weapons by 3
Can spend 10 minutes inspiring up to 6 creatures, granting them temporary HP equal to level + CHA mod
+1 INT
Always know which way is north
Always know the number of hours until next sunrise/sunset
Can accurately recall anything seen or heard within the past month
+1 STR or DEX
Proficiency with light armor
+1 INT
Learn three languages
Can create written ciphers only you and chosen creatures can read
3 luck points per long rest
Can spend a luck point to roll an additional d20 on attack, ability check, or saving throw
Can spend a luck point to impose disadvantage on attack roll against you
When creature within 5 ft casts a spell, can use reaction to make a melee attack
When hit by a spell, advantage on saving throw against it
Melee attacks against spellcasters impose disadvantage on concentration saves
Learn two cantrips from a chosen class spell list
Learn one 1st-level spell from the same list
Cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest
Learn two fighter maneuvers from Battle Master list
Gain one d6 superiority die per short rest
+1 STR or DEX
No disadvantage on Stealth checks from medium armor
Can use DEX mod up to +3 (instead of +2) for AC from medium armor
+10 ft speed
No difficult terrain from dashing
When making melee attack, no opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn
+1 STR or DEX
Proficiency with medium armor and shields
Advantage on melee attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than mount
Can force attacks targeted at mount to target you instead
If mount is subjected to effect that allows DEX save for half damage, mount takes no damage on success and half on failure
+1 INT or WIS
+5 to passive Perception and passive Investigation
Can read lips
When taking the Attack action with a glaive/halberd/quarterstaff/spear, can use bonus action for 1d4 bludgeoning attack with other end
When creature enters reach, can use reaction to make a melee attack against them
+1 in chosen ability score
Proficiency in saving throws for that ability
Can cast ritual spells from a chosen class spell list if you have the spell in a ritual book
Once per turn when rolling weapon damage, can reroll and take either total
When hitting a creature within 5 ft with an opportunity attack, their speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn
Creatures within 5 ft provoke opportunity attacks even with Disengage
When a creature within 5 ft makes an attack against a target other than you, can use reaction to make a melee attack
No disadvantage on ranged attacks at long range
Ignore half and three-quarters cover
Before making a ranged attack, can take -5 to attack roll for +10 damage
When taking the Attack action, can use bonus action to shove with shield
Can add shield AC bonus to DEX saves against spells and effects that target only you
If subjected to effect that allows DEX save for half damage, can use reaction to take no damage
Can try to hide when lightly obscured
When miss a ranged attack while hidden, remaining hidden
Can use action to find a hidden creature with Wisdom (Perception) check

Spell Sniper.prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell
effects: Learn one cantrip requiring an attack roll from any class
Double the range of spells requiring an attack roll
Ignore half and three-quarters cover for spell attacks
+1 STR or CON
Proficiency with improvised weapons
Can grapple as bonus action after hitting with improvised weapon or unarmed strike
+2 HP per level

War Caster.prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell
effects: Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration
Can perform somatic components of spells even with weapons/shield in hands
Can use reaction to cast a spell at a creature that provokes an opportunity attack
Proficiency with any four weapons of choice
